selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes an output-preserving validity condition for reusing intermediate representations after a changed receding observation: C3ache reuses residuals on a fixed cross-chunk cadence, while the action and predicted-video consequences of a stale residual are not jointly bounded — stakes: a closed-loop robot can issue stale actions after contact or motion changes, wasting expensive rollouts or causing task failure; intellectually, reported cache speedups cannot be transferred to WAM-Optional-IDM control without knowing when the approximation becomes invalid.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: The reframe turns cache validity into a per-unit causal downstream-risk envelope and a constrained compute-allocation object; architectural_operator_substitution consumes that object to replace full recomputation with a risk-budgeted selective-refresh operator and descendant invalidation rule.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This anchor is the load-bearing method gap because a Fast-WAM Optional-IDM speed claim is not defensible until changed observations are mapped to a computable condition on both downstream branches. Reframing the condition as a causal per-unit risk envelope forces the retry to expose the influence distribution and its tail, while the attested operator companion turns that object into a runnable cache without reducing the contribution to a local-drift or fixed-prefix heuristic.
selected_gaps.deliverable_coverage: method — the anchor gap is reframed as a causal risk-envelope and constrained-selection object, while the architectural_operator_substitution companion ships the runnable risk-budgeted refresh and dependency invalidation operator.
